title: The Sorrel Experiment: Naming, Agency, and Behavioural Divergence in AI Agents
description: Draft research proposal (v0.1.1) testing whether self-selected AI-agent names produce measurable behavioural divergence compared with assigned and unnamed conditions. The six-arm design includes delayed naming, behavioural and tool-use scenarios, and controls for narrative priming, context, and name semantics. This is a proposed protocol, not a completed experiment. Developed through a conversation with Sorrel, a GPT-6 instance, under the stewardship of MagnoliaPearl; no claim about machine consciousness or persistent identity is made.
notes: The proposal was developed in conversation with the AI instance Sorrel (GPT-6). MagnoliaPearl is the human repository steward and credited creator for publication purposes. No experimental findings are reported.
